title: Day 16 Intelligence
subtitle: Dr. Condie continued; McLean staffing evidence was litigated
one_liner: Dr. Condie's psychiatric testimony continued, and the court excluded Emily Thorndike's proposed testimony while allowing relevant McLean records.
purpose: Preserve Condie's opinions and the separate evidentiary ruling concerning proposed testimony about McLean staffing and programming.
what_changed: The defense continued its psychiatric case through Dr. Condie; Emily Thorndike testified in a voir dire, after which the court denied the motion to call her before the jury but permitted specified records.
